LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_CinderSword.label: Cinder Ash
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_CinderSword.description: Mingyuan's pale cinder blade. It strikes for 44 cut damage with 150% armor penetration, attacks twice in roughly 3 seconds through a 0.5 melee cooldown multiplier, and Mingyuan's flame adds Life Burn on each hit.
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_CinderSword.tools.0.label: Cinder Ash
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_RainbowBow.label: Long Rainbow
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_RainbowBow.description: Mingyuan's longbow of pale gold and red fire. It aims for 4 seconds and fires 4 high-arc arrows at any map-range target. Each arrow deals 10 damage, adds heavier Life Burn, and ricochets up to 6 times among enemies within 5 cells; the same target can be hit by one arrow up to 3 times.
LanguageData.MX_Bullet_Mingyuan_RainbowArrow.label: Long Rainbow Arrow
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_BurningPillarField.label: burning pillar core
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_AshesField.label: ashes of self field
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_InfernoArmor.label: Molten Inferno Armor
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_InfernoArmor.description: Armor cooled from Mingyuan's pale inferno. It covers the body and wings, resists all common damage types, grants extreme heat insulation, adds carrying capacity, improves movement and dodge, and reduces incoming damage while remaining unbreakable.
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_BurningFeatherCrown.label: Turbid Burning Feather Crown
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_BurningFeatherCrown.descript: A white-gold crown threaded with red burning feathers. It steadies Mingyuan's sight, quickens ranged attacks, improves dodge, and turns part of incoming harm aside.
